1.question: Are your iPhones original or refurbished?
1.answer: All our devices are original premium pre-owned Apple products: not refurbished and without replaced parts.

2.question: How is battery health determined?
2.answer: We measure battery capacity with the original Apple diagnostic tools and clearly list this percentage on every product.

3.question: What does the warranty cover?
3.answer: Every device comes with 6 to 12 months of warranty, depending on the product.

4.question: Can I trade in my old device?
4.answer: Sure! Use our trade-in estimator for an indication of the value.

1.title: IMEI and Apple serial number check

2.title: Official Apple diagnostics
2.text: We run the original Apple diagnostic tools to verify battery health, screen performance and components.

3.title: No uncertified parts
3.text: If anything has ever been replaced, it is done with original Apple parts — never with cheap copies.

4.title: Unique photo report per device
4.text: You see the actual device you buy: no stock photos, but clear photos of its real condition.

5.title: 6–12 months warranty
5.text: If anything does come up, we're there for you personally — with warranty on every device.

hero.subtext_default: Not just pre-owned: deliberately selected. We only take in Apple products we would use ourselves, photograph the exact unit you receive and are upfront about condition and battery.

story.intro_default: iSelectStore started with a simple frustration: anyone looking for a second-hand iPhone runs into stacks of generic devices, vague photos and condition descriptions that tell you nothing.
story.body_default:
We do it differently. We only take in what we would want to use ourselves, personally inspect every device and photograph the exact unit you actually receive. We list battery health and condition per device — no averages and no surprises afterwards.

That keeps the range small and accurate, with a fair price-quality ratio and always someone you can actually reach.

values.sub_default: This is what every device has to pass before it goes into the shop.

1.title: Only the good ones
1.text: We select on condition, battery and original parts. Anything that doesn't pass doesn't go online.

2.title: Real photos
2.text: You see the device you buy: photos of this exact unit, no stock imagery.

3.title: Transparency on battery and condition
3.text: Battery percentage and condition are listed per device, so you know what you're buying.

4.title: Personal service
4.text: A question? You get an answer from someone who inspected the device themselves.
